biography.plain_text: Franjo Pašalić is a Croatian entrepreneur who established Marina Frapa in Rogoznica and Dubrovnik through his company Laguna Trade. long_biography.plain_text:
Marina Frapa in Rogoznica combines Franjo Pašalić’s berthing business with two hotels, restaurants and leisure facilities. He has reinvested the marina’s profits in its operation, fitting solar panels across the buildings and introducing compactors for paper and general waste. These installations were intended to reduce electricity and waste-collection costs.

Pašalić also contributed his own money towards buying the Croatian consulate building in Munich during the 1990s, as part of an expatriate fundraising effort. He commissioned a Croatian coat of arms carved from Brač stone and arranged its transport to Germany. The stonework stands at the centre of a fountain in the consulate’s garden.
